findings: The qualified F-KT/F-MR checkpoint and candidate seam already supports candidate-only trial, explicit commit and explicit discard without committed-state mutation.
No F-KT transaction algorithm change is required for F-GC02.
The current F-MR restricted real-physics admission accepts only bottom modes 7 and -2.
HeadCalc implements bottom modes 7 and -2 as free drainage, so forcing%bottom_head is not a controllable groundwater coupling boundary on the admitted physical route.

HeadCalc already contains a specified lower pressure-head route for SWBOTB 5 and explicit state binding already carries request%boundary%bottom_head into state%hbot, but that route is not currently admitted by F-SI/F-MR.
Enabling that route inside F-GC would cross the F-SI/F-MR ownership boundary and would invalidate the scientific-admission constraint.

required_upstream_owner_work.F-SI: Qualify an explicit lower pressure-head boundary through the existing soil-water boundary interface for the same restricted real-physics route, with authoritative returned bottom flux and complete mass accounting.
required_upstream_owner_work.F-MR: After F-SI qualification, admit that exact capability in the restricted serialized physical profile while preserving the existing candidate-only checkpoint orchestration seam.

resume_condition: Resume this same F-GC02 branch only after exact qualified F-SI/F-MR provenance exists for a controllable groundwater lower boundary. Then implement predictor trial, discard, groundwater response, corrector from the same T0 checkpoint, exact interface flux pairing, authoritative mass gate and single accepted commit.
